readme_excerpt: Transformable numerical computing at scale Transformations | Scaling | Install guide | Change logs | Reference docs What is JAX? JAX is a Python library for accelerator-oriented array computation and program transformation, designed for high-performance numerical computing and large-scale machine learning.
